title: ID0399323-DC/Si-D/DK[qntu3k] - Uno-X test charger DC1 cable OoO due to cable temperature error
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
DC1_CableTempeSensorError_XD100
Root cause:
CCS cable faulty (temperature sensor)
Solution:
Replace CCS
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
Siemens
Warranty Status:
Active
Outlet DC1 is out of order due to cable temperature error. We checked all wirings from EcoG → charging cable terminal block and the PT1000 (Blue - Orange) resistance value was changing between 500 ohm - 1500Mohm. We tested another sensor and another cable sensors and values were solid 1008ohm while ambient temperature were around 0 degree celcius.
New ccs2 cable will be ordered and just in case also -KF14.
